data_issues: (1) Label noise: 14 of 63 labeled trials (13/45 train, 1/18 val) have y inconsistent with the stimulus-log movie_time_s (class should be movie_time_s-104); relabeled from movie_time_s. (2) The test set unit (row) order is permuted/scrambled relative to train/val: per-unit firing rates in test do not match train units index-by-index, and a decoder applied naively predicts almost only classes 5/6. I recovered the unit mapping by Hungarian matching of class-conditional PSTHs (EM with the decoder) before predicting.
